comment: The tracked DEPLOYMENT PROFILE for the tilefoundry-npu adapter.
This is the versioned half of the deployment contract: it states what a
correct deployment must look like, so git show can answer whether a given
deployment was right without the machine-local, git-ignored env.sh.
It contains no secrets, no host paths and no usernames. Local paths live in
env.sh and their key-set is hashed per run as effective_config_sha256, so a
run that used a different configuration is detectable without publishing it.

notes.character_device: Each device node inside the container must be a character device; a regular file with the same name is a deployment fault.
notes.pinned_by_digest: required_image_digest pins the IMAGE ID, not the tag. A tag can be rebuilt in place; the digest cannot. provision.py refuses IMAGE_TAG_MOVED rather than measuring a silently replaced image.
notes.binds_are_identical_paths: The host and the container see the same path (bind_source_equals_destination). A bind whose source differs is a different filesystem even when the destination looks right.
notes.no_exclusive_or_busy_flag: No configuration value can make the gate wait for, refuse, skip or downgrade a busy card. Occupancy is recorded metadata only.
